nodes.label: Patient has rising PSA levels despite androgen deprivation therapy
Patient is a 70-year-old male with a history of primary radiotherapy for prostate cancer
PSA level is 6 ng/mL and PSA doubling time is 6.6 months
Patient was evaluated at a tertiary referral institution; no specific physical examination findings were detailed in the report
Testosterone level is confirmed to be in castrate range
PSA shows three consecutive rises with two 50% increases over nadir and PSA >2 ng/mL
There is no biopsy confirmation of neuroendocrine transformation
No contemporaneous imaging is available at PSA progression
Radiologist recommends PSMA PET/CT for definitive staging of CRPC
Laboratory physician recommends contemporaneous bone scan or CT to finalize staging
